svg.title: Multi-agent architecture for personalized medicine
svg.desc: Four-tier flowchart: patient data streams feed a master orchestrator, which delegates to specialist agents (genomic risk, drug safety, literature search, biomarker), which produce clinical outputs (risk assessment, treatment plan, therapy design), all under physician oversight.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is genome sequencing data processed by medical AI agents?')
sendPrompt('What EHR data do medical AI agents analyze?')
sendPrompt('What wearable sensor data feeds into personalized medicine agents?')
sendPrompt('What diagnostic tests feed into the AI agent system?')
sendPrompt('What does the master orchestrator agent do in personalized medicine?')
sendPrompt('How does the genomic risk agent analyze genetic variants and polygenic risk scores?')
sendPrompt('How does the drug safety agent check for pharmacogenomic interactions?')
sendPrompt('How does the literature search agent find relevant clinical trials and evidence?')
sendPrompt('How does the biomarker agent detect health signals from continuous sensors?')
sendPrompt('What does a personalized risk assessment output from AI agents look like?')
sendPrompt('How do agents generate personalized dosage and treatment plans?')
sendPrompt('How do agents design personalized mRNA or gene therapies?')
sendPrompt('How does physician oversight and human-in-the-loop work in AI-driven medicine?')
